subject.title: feat(codex): run remote workspaces without splitting app-server

question: Should this draft introduce an experimental Codex remote-execution config in the bundled plugin before live registry-backed proof exists, or should it wait until proof and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101221 reconciliation are complete?
rationale: The architecture matches the canonical issue direction, but it adds new remote execution, credential, session-binding, and fail-closed compatibility behavior that automation cannot accept without maintainer security/product intent.

options.title: Hold for proof and reconciliation
options.body: Keep the PR open as a draft until it is conflict-free, reconciled with the app-server 0.142/lifecycle PR, and backed by a redacted live registry executor run.

options.title: Accept experimental security risk
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly sponsor the experimental config while owning the remaining live-proof and operator-compatibility risk.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Leave the design tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101282 if the upstream registry contract or OpenClaw product boundary is not ready.

recommendation.title: Hold for proof and reconciliation
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open as a draft until it is conflict-free, reconciled with the app-server 0.142/lifecycle PR, and backed by a redacted live registry executor run.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current draft and has the strongest recent history on the related Codex app-server lifecycle/session surfaces.
